name: 🔥 Fire Blaster Race
description: Race blazing karts on 10 wild tracks: Lava Loop, Star Highway, Frost Peak, Neon Night City and more! Drift around corners to charge your Fire Boost, smash item boxes for Fireballs, Homing Blasters, Oil Slicks and Inferno Mode, and blast your way to 1st place. Win coins, unlock 8 karts and flame colors, and race with friends or CPU rivals any time. Level up, finish daily quests, unlock racer titles, paint your kart and set track records. Vote for the next track and climb the Wins leaderboard!
